module_name_en: Core Words III and Graded Reading
block_note: Nine news reports. Every claim is attributed, as the level 32 item established, and the texts are updated to include natural passive voice constructions now that the receptive grammar prep card is active.
review_flags: Real Hindi news uses the जाना passive constantly — कहा गया, फ़ैसला लिया गया, जाँच के आदेश दिए गए. Module 14 teaches it at level 24. We have updated these news texts to read more naturally using natural passive constructions now that the receptive pull-forward strategy is implemented.

grammar_prep_card.explanation_en: Real Hindi news reports and official announcements use the passive voice constantly to state events objectively without naming the agent. The passive is formed by taking the perfective participle of the main verb and adding inflected forms of 'जाना' (to go) as an auxiliary. For example, 'जाँच के आदेश दिए गए हैं' (Orders for an investigation have been given) or 'रिपोर्ट भेजी गई' (The report was sent). Both the participle and 'जाना' agree with the patient of the verb in gender and number.

examples.hindi: जाँच के आदेश दिए गए हैं।
examples.read_as: jaanch ke aadesh die gae haiṁ.
examples.english: Orders for an investigation have been given.

lines.hindi: शहर के दो मोहल्लों के बीच पानी का विवाद बढ़ गया है
lines.read_as: shahar ke do muhalloṁ ke biich paanii kaa vivaad baṛh gayaa hai
lines.english: A dispute over water between two neighbourhoods of the city has grown

lines.hindi: एक पक्ष का आरोप है कि दूसरा पक्ष ज़्यादा पानी ले रहा है
lines.read_as: ek pakṣ kaa aarop hai ki duusraa pakṣ zyaadaa paanii le rahaa hai
lines.english: One side alleges that the other is taking too much water

lines.hindi: दूसरे पक्ष ने इस आरोप से इनकार किया
lines.read_as: duusre pakṣ ne is aarop se inkaar kiyaa
lines.english: The other side has denied the allegation

lines.hindi: नगर निगम के द्वारा दोनों पक्षों को बातचीत के लिए बुलाया गया
lines.read_as: nagar nigam ke dvaaraa donoṁ pakṣoṁ ko baatchiit ke lie bulaayaa gayaa
lines.english: Both sides were called for talks by the municipal corporation

lines.hindi: अधिकारियों के अनुसार पानी में कोई कमी नहीं है
lines.read_as: adhikaariyoṁ ke anusaar paanii meṁ koii kamii nahiiṁ hai
lines.english: According to officials there is no shortage of water

lines.hindi: अगली बैठक अगले सोमवार को होगी
lines.read_as: aglii baiṭhak agle somvaar ko hogii
lines.english: The next meeting will be on Monday

learn.title_en: आरोप, इनकार, और के अनुसार — the three moves of a news report
learn.explanation_en: आरोप is an allegation, masculine, and it goes with लगाना or simply sits in आरोप है कि. Its answering move is इनकार करना, to deny, and the thing denied takes से. Watch what the six lines do: allegation, denial, official position. Nothing is asserted by the report itself. And पक्ष here is exactly the word you learned in level 13 — a side in a dispute, never a physical side.
learn.register_note_en: आरोप (news, legal) · इल्ज़ाम (Urdu-side, and what a person says in an argument). Both are masculine.
vocabulary_notes: मोहल्ला — a neighbourhood, masculine, and oblique plural मोहल्लों before के बीच.
विवाद — a dispute. विवादित means disputed.
बातचीत — talks, another echo compound like पूछताछ from level 8.

practice.question_en: What has the municipal corporation done?
practice.explanation_en: Line 4: दोनों पक्षों को बातचीत के लिए बुलाया.

game.question_en: What does the officials' statement add that neither side has said?
options: That the dispute is not about water at all
That the problem is how the water is shared, not how much there is
game.explanation_en: If there is no shortage, then a quarrel about who takes more is a quarrel about distribution. The report never says so; putting the two lines together does.

lines.hindi: कल शाम बाज़ार में आग लगने की घटना हुई
lines.read_as: kal shaam baazaar meṁ aag lagne kii ghaṭnaa huii
lines.english: There was a fire in the market yesterday evening

lines.hindi: दुकानदारों के अनुसार आग एक दुकान से शुरू हुई
lines.read_as: dukaandaaroṁ ke anusaar aag ek dukaan se shuruu huii
lines.english: According to shopkeepers the fire started in one shop

lines.hindi: दमकल की गाड़ियाँ आधे घंटे में पहुँचीं
lines.read_as: damkal kii gaaṛiyaaṁ aadhe ghanṭe meṁ pahuṁchiiṁ
lines.english: Fire engines arrived within half an hour

lines.hindi: किसी के घायल होने की ख़बर नहीं है
lines.read_as: kisii ke ghaayal hone kii ḳhabar nahiiṁ hai
lines.english: There are no reports of anyone being injured

lines.hindi: नगर निगम की प्रतिक्रिया देर से आई
lines.read_as: nagar nigam kii pratikriyaa der se aaii
lines.english: The municipal corporation's response came late

lines.hindi: अधिकारियों ने कहा कि कारण अभी स्पष्ट नहीं है
lines.read_as: adhikaariyoṁ ne kahaa ki kaaraṇ abhii spaṣṭ nahiiṁ hai
lines.english: Officials said the cause is not yet clear

lines.hindi: दुकानदारों ने जल्द मुआवज़े की माँग की है
lines.read_as: dukaandaaroṁ ne jald muaavze kii maaṁg kii hai
lines.english: Shopkeepers have demanded prompt compensation

lines.hindi: देरी पर सवाल उठे हैं
lines.read_as: derii par savaal uṭhe haiṁ
lines.english: Questions have been raised about the delay

learn.explanation_en: प्रति- means back or in return, and क्रिया is an action, so प्रतिक्रिया is a reaction — and in news it means an official's public response. It ends in -आ and is feminine, joining the class from level 35, and the same प्रति- gave you प्रत्युत्तर in level 26 and प्रतिदिन on the cloakroom sign. Note घटना in line 1: also -आ, also feminine, also from that class.
learn.register_note_en: प्रतिक्रिया is what news calls a statement made in answer to something. A person reacting to news would just say उसने क्या कहा?
vocabulary_notes: दमकल — a fire engine, feminine. दमकल की गाड़ियाँ is the usual phrase.
घायल — injured, invariable. घायल होना, to be hurt.
मुआवज़ा — compensation, masculine and Urdu-side. Oblique मुआवज़े before की.

options: There are no reports of injuries
The report does not mention it
practice.explanation_en: Line 4: किसी के घायल होने की ख़बर नहीं है.

game.question_en: Line 3 says the engines arrived in half an hour and line 5 says the response was late. Do they contradict each other?
options: No — two different things are meant: the statement was late, not the fire engines
Yes, half an hour is the delay being complained about
No, the corporation sent the engines
game.explanation_en: प्रतिक्रिया is the corporation's public statement, not its emergency response. A reader who takes it for the latter will find the report incoherent.

lines.hindi: राज्य सरकार ने एक नई समिति का गठन किया है
lines.read_as: raajya sarkaar ne ek naii samiti kaa gaṭhan kiyaa hai
lines.english: The state government has constituted a new committee

lines.hindi: समिति शिक्षा नीति की समीक्षा करेगी
lines.read_as: samiti shikṣaa niiti kii samiikṣaa karegii
lines.english: The committee will review education policy

lines.hindi: इसमें पाँच सदस्य हैं
lines.read_as: ismeṁ paaṁch sadasya haiṁ
lines.english: It has five members

lines.hindi: समिति तीन महीने में अपनी रिपोर्ट देगी
lines.read_as: samiti tiin mahiine meṁ apnii riporṭ degii
lines.english: The committee will submit its report in three months

lines.hindi: शिक्षा मंत्री के अनुसार यह क़दम ज़रूरी था
lines.read_as: shikṣaa maṁtrii ke anusaar yah qadam zaruurii thaa
lines.english: According to the education minister this step was necessary

lines.hindi: कुछ शिक्षक संगठनों ने गठन का स्वागत किया
lines.read_as: kuchh shikṣak saṁgaṭhanoṁ ne gaṭhan kaa svaagat kiyaa
lines.english: Some teachers' organisations have welcomed the formation

lines.hindi: दूसरों ने कहा कि समिति में शिक्षकों का प्रतिनिधित्व कम है
lines.read_as: duusroṁ ne kahaa ki samiti meṁ shikṣakoṁ kaa pratinidhitv kam hai
lines.english: Others said teachers are under-represented on the committee

lines.hindi: सरकार ने अभी कुछ नहीं कहा
lines.read_as: sarkaar ne abhii kuchh nahiiṁ kahaa
lines.english: The government has said nothing so far

learn.explanation_en: गठन is a formation or constitution, from गठना, and समिति का गठन करना is the fixed phrase for setting up a committee. The suffix -न builds masculine nouns of action: गठन, खंडन, निर्माण's relative वहन, and the pattern behind many news words. It joins -आव from level 34 as a second masculine noun-maker, against the four feminine ones. Note शिक्षक and शिक्षकों here — the -क agent suffix from level 30, and the oblique plural before का.
learn.register_note_en: समिति (news, official) · कमेटी (English, and completely ordinary in speech, including in offices).
vocabulary_notes: समीक्षा — a review, another -आ feminine.
प्रतिनिधित्व — representation, from प्रतिनिधि, a representative. The प्रति- prefix again.
क़दम — a step, masculine, Urdu-side.

game.question_en: What is the position at the end of the report?
options: The government has accepted the criticism
The criticism has been made and not answered
game.explanation_en: An objection is raised in one line and the next records silence. Putting them in that order is how a report leaves a question open without asking it.

summary.recap_en: A news report moves in attributed steps: allegation, denial, official position, and nothing said in its own voice. प्रति- means back — प्रतिक्रिया, प्रत्युत्तर, प्रतिदिन. And -न joins -आव as a second masculine noun-building suffix, against four feminine ones.
summary.next_up_en: Next: a proposal, a rise and a fall — and two suffixes that differ only by three letters.

lines.hindi: नगर निगम की बैठक में एक प्रस्ताव पारित हुआ
lines.read_as: nagar nigam kii baiṭhak meṁ ek prastaav paarit huaa
lines.english: A proposal was passed at the municipal corporation's meeting

lines.hindi: शहर के पुराने बाज़ार क्षेत्र में नई पार्किंग बनेगी
lines.read_as: shahar ke puraane baazaar kṣetra meṁ naii paarkiṁg banegii
lines.english: A new car park will be built in the old market area

lines.hindi: इस पर लगभग दो करोड़ रुपये का ख़र्च आएगा
lines.read_as: is par lagbhag do karoṛ rupae kaa ḳharch aaegaa
lines.english: It will cost about two crore rupees

lines.hindi: काम अगले वित्त वर्ष में शुरू होगा
lines.read_as: kaam agle vitt varṣ meṁ shuruu hogaa
lines.english: Work will begin in the next financial year

lines.hindi: दुकानदारों ने प्रस्ताव का स्वागत किया है
lines.read_as: dukaandaaroṁ ne prastaav kaa svaagat kiyaa hai
lines.english: Shopkeepers have welcomed the proposal

lines.hindi: उनके अनुसार पार्किंग ही सबसे बड़ी दिक्कत है
lines.read_as: unke anusaar paarkiṁg hii sabse baṛii dikkat hai
lines.english: In their view parking is the biggest difficulty

lines.hindi: कुछ निवासियों ने शोर और धूल की आशंका भी जताई
lines.read_as: kuchh nivaasiyoṁ ne shor aur dhuul kii aashaṁkaa bhii jataaii
lines.english: Some residents have also expressed concern about noise and dust

lines.hindi: निगम ने कहा कि रात में काम नहीं होगा
lines.read_as: nigam ne kahaa ki raat meṁ kaam nahiiṁ hogaa
lines.english: The corporation said there will be no work at night

learn.title_en: करोड़ and लाख — the numbers Indian news counts in
learn.explanation_en: पारित means passed or adopted, and it is another invariable Sanskrit participle like समाप्त, उपस्थित and प्रस्तुत. But the thing that will slow you down in this text is दो करोड़. Indian numbering groups by लाख, a hundred thousand, and करोड़, ten million — not by millions and billions. दो करोड़ is twenty million, and no amount of vocabulary will help if the unit itself is unfamiliar. Any news report about money will be written this way.
learn.register_note_en: पारित (news, official records) · पास होना (everyday, and also used in news headlines). प्रस्ताव पास हो गया is perfectly ordinary.
vocabulary_notes: क्षेत्र — an area or zone, masculine and formal. इलाक़ा is the Urdu-side partner.
वित्त वर्ष — financial year. वित्त, finance, from level 37.
आशंका — apprehension, another -आ feminine. जताना, to express, is taught properly at level 45.

game.question_en: Why does the corporation mention night work at all?
options: It is answering the residents' concern without naming it
Night work is not permitted by law
game.explanation_en: Nobody asked about hours. The line only makes sense as a reply to the complaint about noise in the line before it.

lines.hindi: शहर में बिजली की खपत में इस साल दस प्रतिशत की वृद्धि हुई है
lines.read_as: shahar meṁ bijlii kii khapat meṁ is saal das pratishat kii vriddhi huii hai
lines.english: Electricity consumption in the city has risen ten per cent this year

lines.hindi: बिजली विभाग के अनुसार गर्मी इसका मुख्य कारण है
lines.read_as: bijlii vibhaag ke anusaar garmii iskaa mukhya kaaraṇ hai
lines.english: According to the electricity department, heat is the main cause

lines.hindi: पिछले तीन सालों में यह सबसे बड़ी वृद्धि है
lines.read_as: pichhle tiin saaloṁ meṁ yah sabse baṛii vriddhi hai
lines.english: This is the largest rise in three years

lines.hindi: विभाग ने कहा कि बिजली की कमी नहीं होगी
lines.read_as: vibhaag ne kahaa ki bijlii kii kamii nahiiṁ hogii
lines.english: The department said there will be no shortage

lines.hindi: नए कनेक्शनों की संख्या भी बढ़ी है
lines.read_as: nae kanekshanoṁ kii saṁkhyaa bhii baṛhii hai
lines.english: The number of new connections has also grown

lines.hindi: एक साल में बारह हज़ार नए कनेक्शन जुड़े
lines.read_as: ek saal meṁ baarah hazaar nae kanekshan juṛe
lines.english: Twelve thousand new connections were added in one year

lines.hindi: विशेषज्ञों के अनुसार यह वृद्धि आगे भी जारी रहेगी
lines.read_as: visheṣagyoṁ ke anusaar yah vriddhi aage bhii jaarii rahegii
lines.english: Experts say the rise will continue

lines.hindi: विभाग अगले महीने नई दरें घोषित करेगा
lines.read_as: vibhaag agle mahiine naii dareṁ ghoṣit karegaa
lines.english: The department will announce new rates next month

learn.explanation_en: वृद्धि is an increase, and it is feminine — it belongs with the -ति and -धि nouns like स्वीकृति, प्रगति and बुद्धि, all of which are feminine. The word to take away from this text, though, is प्रतिशत: प्रति, per, which you first met on the parking sign in level 7, plus शत, hundred. Per cent, built from two pieces you already had. And घोषित in the last line is the participle of घोषणा from level 35.
learn.register_note_en: वृद्धि (news, official) · बढ़ोतरी (also news, and slightly more everyday) · simply बढ़ना in speech.
vocabulary_notes: खपत — consumption, feminine.
संख्या — a number or count, another -आ feminine.
दरें — rates, the plural of दर, feminine. विशेषज्ञ — an expert, masculine.

practice.question_en: What reason does the department give for the rise?
practice.explanation_en: Line 2: गर्मी इसका मुख्य कारण है.

game.question_en: The department promises no shortage and then announces new rates. What might connect the two?
options: There will be a shortage after all
The rates are unrelated to the rise
Rising demand is being handled through price rather than supply
game.explanation_en: Neither line explains itself. Read together, a promise to keep supply steady followed by a rate announcement suggests where the adjustment is going to fall.

lines.hindi: पिछले महीने शहर में सड़क दुर्घटनाओं में गिरावट आई है
lines.read_as: pichhle mahiine shahar meṁ saṛak durghaṭnaaoṁ meṁ giraavaṭ aaii hai
lines.english: Road accidents in the city fell last month

lines.hindi: पुलिस के अनुसार दुर्घटनाओं की संख्या में पंद्रह प्रतिशत की कमी हुई
lines.read_as: pulis ke anusaar durghaṭnaaoṁ kii saṁkhyaa meṁ paṁdrah pratishat kii kamii huii
lines.english: According to police the number of accidents dropped fifteen per cent

lines.hindi: नए ट्रैफ़िक सिग्नल और सड़क मरम्मत इसका कारण हो सकते हैं
lines.read_as: nae ṭraifik signal aur saṛak marammat iskaa kaaraṇ ho sakte haiṁ
lines.english: New traffic signals and road repairs may be the reason

lines.hindi: सबसे ज़्यादा गिरावट रात के समय दर्ज हुई
lines.read_as: sabse zyaadaa giraavaṭ raat ke samay darj huii
lines.english: The biggest fall was recorded at night

lines.hindi: दोपहिया वाहनों की घटनाएँ अब भी ज़्यादा हैं
lines.read_as: dopahiyaa vaahanoṁ kii ghaṭnaaeṁ ab bhii zyaadaa haiṁ
lines.english: Incidents involving two-wheelers are still high

lines.hindi: पुलिस हेलमेट पर सख़्ती जारी रखेगी
lines.read_as: pulis helmeṭ par saḳhtii jaarii rakhegii
lines.english: Police will keep up enforcement on helmets

lines.hindi: अगले महीने से नए नियम लागू होंगे
lines.read_as: agle mahiine se nae niyam laaguu hoṁge
lines.english: New rules come into force next month

lines.hindi: विभाग अब हर महीने ये आँकड़े जारी करेगा
lines.read_as: vibhaag ab har mahiine ye aaṁkaṛe jaarii karegaa
lines.english: The department will now release these figures monthly

learn.title_en: -आवट and -आव, three letters apart and opposite genders
learn.explanation_en: गिरावट is a fall, built from गिरना with the suffix -आवट — and -आवट builds feminine nouns: गिरावट, सजावट decoration, बनावट construction or make, थकावट tiredness, मिलावट adulteration. Set that beside -आव from level 34, which builds masculines from the very same verbs: बनाव against बनावट, both from बनना, and one is masculine while the other is feminine. Three letters of difference and the gender flips.
learn.register_note_en: गिरावट (news, markets) · कमी (everywhere, and used in line 2 of this very text). The report uses both, one line apart.
vocabulary_notes: दुर्घटना — an accident, from दुर्- bad plus घटना an event. Another -आ feminine.
दर्ज होना — to be recorded. दर्ज करना, to register something.
सख़्ती — strictness, from सख़्त with the -ई suffix, so feminine.

practice.question_en: By how much did accidents fall?

game.question_en: What is हो सकते हैं doing at the end of line 3?
options: Offering a possible cause without claiming it is proven
Denying that there is any cause
game.explanation_en: The figure in line 2 is attributed and firm; the explanation in line 3 is hedged. The police are not being given the credit, and the hedge is the only thing withholding it.

summary.recap_en: Indian news counts in लाख and करोड़, not millions. प्रतिशत is प्रति plus शत, per hundred, built from a piece you had since level 7. And -आवट builds feminine nouns from the same verbs that -आव builds masculines from — बनाव and बनावट, three letters apart and opposite genders.
summary.next_up_en: Next: a survey, a denial and an investigation — the longest news items in the module.

lines.hindi: एक सर्वेक्षण ने शहर के लोगों से सार्वजनिक परिवहन के बारे में पूछा
lines.read_as: ek sarvekṣaṇ ne shahar ke logoṁ se saarvajanik parivahan ke baare meṁ puuchhaa
lines.english: A survey asked people in the city about public transport

lines.hindi: साठ प्रतिशत लोगों ने कहा कि बस सेवा में सुधार ज़रूरी है
lines.read_as: saaṭh pratishat logoṁ ne kahaa ki bas sevaa meṁ sudhaar zaruurii hai
lines.english: Sixty per cent said the bus service needs improvement

lines.hindi: पैंतीस प्रतिशत ने किराए को सबसे बड़ी समस्या बताया
lines.read_as: paiṁtiis pratishat ne kiraae ko sabse baṛii samasyaa bataayaa
lines.english: Thirty-five per cent named the fare as the biggest problem

lines.hindi: केवल दस प्रतिशत लोग मौजूदा व्यवस्था से संतुष्ट हैं
lines.read_as: keval das pratishat log maujuudaa vyavasthaa se saṁtuṣṭ haiṁ
lines.english: Only ten per cent are satisfied with the current system

lines.hindi: सर्वेक्षण में दो हज़ार लोगों ने हिस्सा लिया
lines.read_as: sarvekṣaṇ meṁ do hazaar logoṁ ne hissaa liyaa
lines.english: Two thousand people took part in the survey

lines.hindi: महिलाओं ने सुरक्षा को सबसे ज़रूरी मुद्दा बताया
lines.read_as: mahilaaoṁ ne surakṣaa ko sabse zaruurii muddaa bataayaa
lines.english: Women named safety as the most important issue

lines.hindi: परिवहन विभाग ने सर्वेक्षण के नतीजों पर विचार करने की बात कही
lines.read_as: parivahan vibhaag ne sarvekṣaṇ ke natiijoṁ par vichaar karne kii baat kahii
lines.english: The transport department said it would consider the survey's findings

lines.hindi: नई योजना अगले साल आ सकती है
lines.read_as: naii yojnaa agle saal aa saktii hai
lines.english: A new scheme may come next year

learn.explanation_en: सर्वेक्षण is a survey — सर्व, all, plus ईक्षण, viewing — and the -ण suffix builds masculine action nouns: सर्वेक्षण, प्रशिक्षण training, निर्माण construction, वितरण distribution, निरीक्षण inspection. That is now three masculine noun suffixes, -आव, -न and -ण, against five feminine ones. Note also नतीजा in line 7, the Urdu-side partner of परिणाम, which you met as an option in level 17.
learn.register_note_en: सर्वेक्षण (news, official) · सर्वे (English, and much commoner in speech and even in headlines).
vocabulary_notes: सार्वजनिक — public, from सर्व. परिवहन — transport.
मौजूदा — current or existing, Urdu-side and invariable despite the -आ.
हिस्सा लेना — to take part. हिस्सा is a share or part, masculine.

practice.explanation_en: Line 5: दो हज़ार लोगों ने हिस्सा लिया.

game.question_en: The percentages in lines 2, 3 and 4 add up to more than a hundred. What follows?
options: People could give more than one answer, or these were separate questions
game.explanation_en: Sixty, thirty-five and ten cannot be exclusive shares of the same whole. Nothing in the text says the questions were separate; the arithmetic does.

lines.hindi: शिक्षा विभाग ने स्कूल भवनों की हालत पर आरोपों का खंडन किया है
lines.read_as: shikṣaa vibhaag ne skuul bhavanoṁ kii haalat par aaropoṁ kaa khaṁḍan kiyaa hai
lines.english: The education department has denied allegations about the condition of school buildings

lines.hindi: एक स्थानीय संगठन ने कहा था कि कई स्कूलों में छत टपकती है
lines.read_as: ek sthaaniiya saṁgaṭhan ne kahaa thaa ki kaii skuuloṁ meṁ chhat ṭapaktii hai
lines.english: A local organisation had said that roofs leak in several schools

lines.hindi: विभाग के एक अधिकारी ने इसे ग़लत बताया
lines.read_as: vibhaag ke ek adhikaarii ne ise ġalat bataayaa
lines.english: An official of the department called this incorrect

lines.hindi: उनके अनुसार पिछले साल सभी भवनों की मरम्मत हुई थी
lines.read_as: unke anusaar pichhle saal sabhii bhavanoṁ kii marammat huii thii
lines.english: According to him all the buildings were repaired last year

lines.hindi: संगठन ने अपने दावे के समर्थन में तस्वीरें दिखाईं
lines.read_as: saṁgaṭhan ne apne daave ke samarthan meṁ tasviireṁ dikhaaiiṁ
lines.english: The organisation showed photographs in support of its claim

lines.hindi: विभाग ने कहा कि वो दोबारा निरीक्षण कराएगा
lines.read_as: vibhaag ne kahaa ki vo dobaaraa niriikṣaṇ karaaegaa
lines.english: The department said it would carry out another inspection

lines.hindi: निरीक्षण अगले सप्ताह से शुरू होगा
lines.read_as: niriikṣaṇ agle saptaah se shuruu hogaa
lines.english: The inspection will begin next week

lines.hindi: संगठन ने इसे बहुत देर का क़दम बताया
lines.read_as: saṁgaṭhan ne ise bahut der kaa qadam bataayaa
lines.english: The organisation called it a very belated step

lines.hindi: मामला अभी ख़त्म नहीं हुआ
lines.read_as: maamlaa abhii ḳhatm nahiiṁ huaa
lines.english: The matter is not over

learn.explanation_en: खंडन is a denial or refutation, and it goes with करना. But look at line 5: अपने दावे के समर्थन में — in support of its claim. समर्थन is the word you learned in level 17 as backing a position rather than helping a person, and here it is doing precisely that job in a phrase where मदद would be impossible. That is what these reading blocks are for: the vocabulary block gives you the distinction, and the report shows you the distinction being used.
learn.register_note_en: खंडन (news, official statements) · इनकार (also common, and used in the level 38 item) · मना करना (speech, and closer to refusing than denying).
vocabulary_notes: दावा — a claim, masculine and Urdu-side. दावे is the oblique.
निरीक्षण — inspection, another -ण noun, and here with the second causative कराएगा.
छत टपकती है — the roof drips. टपकना, the same verb as the leaking tap in Module 12.

practice.question_en: What did the organisation produce in support of its claim?

game.question_en: The department denies the claim and then orders a fresh inspection. What does that combination suggest?
options: The organisation has withdrawn its claim
The department has accepted the claim
The denial is not being left to stand on its own
game.explanation_en: A confident denial needs nothing after it. Ordering an inspection concedes that the question is open, without saying so.

lines.hindi: ज़िला प्रशासन ने एक पुल की हालत की जाँच के आदेश दिए हैं
lines.read_as: zilaa prashaasan ne ek pul kii haalat kii jaaṁch ke aadesh die haiṁ
lines.english: The district administration has ordered an inspection of a bridge's condition

lines.hindi: पिछले हफ़्ते पुल के एक हिस्से में दरार दिखी थी
lines.read_as: pichhle hafte pul ke ek hisse meṁ daraar dikhii thii
lines.english: A crack was seen in part of the bridge last week

lines.hindi: स्थानीय लोगों ने इसकी शिकायत की थी
lines.read_as: sthaaniiya logoṁ ne iskii shikaayat kii thii
lines.english: Local people had complained about it

lines.hindi: जाँच में इंजीनियरों की एक टीम शामिल होगी
lines.read_as: jaaṁch meṁ inijiniyaroṁ kii ek ṭiim shaamil hogii
lines.english: A team of engineers will take part in the investigation

lines.hindi: रिपोर्ट पंद्रह दिन में आएगी
lines.read_as: riporṭ paṁdrah din meṁ aaegii
lines.english: The report will come in fifteen days

lines.hindi: तब तक पुल पर भारी वाहनों की आवाजाही बंद रहेगी
lines.read_as: tab tak pul par bhaarii vaahanoṁ kii aavaajaahii baṁd rahegii
lines.english: Until then heavy vehicles will not be allowed on the bridge

lines.hindi: इससे शहर के पूर्वी हिस्से का रास्ता लंबा हो जाएगा
lines.read_as: isse shahar ke puurvii hisse kaa raastaa laṁbaa ho jaaegaa
lines.english: This will lengthen the route to the eastern part of the city

lines.hindi: प्रशासन ने वैकल्पिक रास्ते की जानकारी दी है
lines.read_as: prashaasan ne vaikalpik raaste kii jaankaarii dii hai
lines.english: The administration has given details of an alternative route

lines.hindi: अधिकारी के अनुसार सुरक्षा सबसे पहले है
lines.read_as: adhikaarii ke anusaar surakṣaa sabse pahle hai
lines.english: According to an official, safety comes first

lines.hindi: जाँच पूरी होने तक फ़ैसला नहीं होगा
lines.read_as: jaaṁch puurii hone tak faislaa nahiiṁ hogaa
lines.english: No decision will be taken until the investigation is complete

learn.title_en: जाँच covers an inspection, an investigation and a blood test
learn.explanation_en: जाँच is feminine and its range is unusually wide: a doctor ordering one in Module 12, a police investigation, a quality check on a factory line, and here a structural inspection of a bridge. English needs three or four words for that span and Hindi uses one, with the surrounding nouns doing the narrowing. Note आवाजाही in line 6 — movement or traffic — which is आना-जाना, the paired verb from level 8, turned into a noun.
learn.register_note_en: जाँच works at every level of formality. जाँच करना, जाँच होना, जाँच के आदेश देना — all current, in speech and in official writing alike.
vocabulary_notes: ज़िला — a district, masculine. प्रशासन — administration, from level 34's game.
दरार — a crack, feminine. वैकल्पिक — alternative, from विकल्प, an option.
जाँच पूरी होने तक — the oblique infinitive plus तक, meaning until.

practice.question_en: What will happen to heavy vehicles?
options: They will be charged a toll
They will not be allowed on the bridge
practice.explanation_en: Line 6: भारी वाहनों की आवाजाही बंद रहेगी.

game.question_en: What does line 3 change about how you read line 1?
options: It blames local people for the damage
It has no bearing on the order
It shows the administration found the crack itself
It shows the administration acted after being told, not on its own initiative
game.explanation_en: The order comes first in the report and the complaint comes third. Read in sequence, the administration is responding rather than discovering, which changes the credit due to it.

summary.recap_en: -ण is a third masculine noun suffix after -आव and -न, against five feminine ones. समर्थन turns up doing exactly the job level 17 described, in a phrase where मदद would be impossible. And जाँच covers an inspection, an investigation and a medical test with one word.
summary.next_up_en: Next: back to vocabulary — technology, and the first of the advanced verbs.
